rules.note: A development counts toward the DC analysis once a water or wastewater site servicing permit is applied for or issued on its site. Site servicing permits are local Building Code permits for private-side pipes, not the Region's servicing application. Storm-only permits are local servicing and do not count. Septic (private sewage) sites are outside the Regional count.
rules.scope: Developments in the pipeline (pre-application to under construction) adding homes or floor area.

buckets.counted: Water / wastewater site servicing permit applied for or issued
buckets.existingOnly: Servicing permits only for existing buildings: not counted, review
buckets.private: Privately serviced (septic): outside the Regional DC count
buckets.permitNoSvc: Building permit but no site servicing permit (often serviced through a subdivision agreement): not counted
